title: FunLand Offical Resource Pack
description: This Pack was made for the FunLand Event on Simple Flip's Minecraft Server.
body:
## This Pack was made for the Simple Flips Minecraft Server, specifically for the Fun Land Event

The event hosted by me! 

The pack only adds in a coin re-texture if a gold nugget is renamed "FunLand Token". 

It also changes a few blocks to make them more fun! :3

Credits: CaptAlex - Texturing / Coding
